## Quality checklist

- [ ] `pnpm validate` passes locally
- [ ] Conventional Commits used (`feat:`, `fix:`, etc.)
- [ ] Branch follows naming convention (`feature/*`, `bugfix/*`, etc.)
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
